$comment: Committed field allowlist for the public open-data download. Rule: if a field is not rendered on a public page today, it is not in the download. Source is always the committed TS/JSON data modules in src/data — never a database, never a live fetch, never a file generated on EC2.
principle: rendered-on-a-public-page => eligible; everything else is denied even if it exists in the source module

globalDeny.description: Fields, values and rows that must never reach a download file, regardless of dataset.
deniedCategories: rows with an empty / missing source URL
rows whose only provenance is LinkedIn, Crunchbase or PitchBook

deniedValuePatterns.phone: a `+`-prefixed run of digits/spaces/./()/- holding >=9 digits and not a percentage (so "+15.5-18.1%" stays a statistic, "+971 50 123 4567" is denied)

globalDeny.notes: Natural-person names are excluded structurally: no allowlisted dataset contains a person field. Editorial prose is excluded by omitting the rendered `detail` (project timeline) and `whyItMatters` (news) fields. Free-text `notes` (open calls) is excluded.

excludedSourceFields.countdown.nextWindow / countdown.nextExp: not rendered as a field; folded into deadline_*

excludedRenderedFields.sponsors: third-party sponsor/partner lists — not part of the open-data grant; excluded to keep corporate attributions out of a redistributable file

sourceUrlSynthetic.reason: A domain is the Atlas's own taxonomy row, not a third-party record. Its only honest public provenance is the directory page that renders it — no external URL is invented.

excludedSourceFields.playerIds: internal join keys, not rendered — only the rendered count is emitted as player_count

sourceUrlSynthetic.reason: Every milestone row is derived from a real commit in this repository (the same repo Terms of Service links to), so the commit URL is the row's real provenance.

excludedDatasets.note: Anything not rendered on a public page today is out: internal/analytical modules (claims, evidence, players, devrelSignal, market-reality panels, personas, systemNodes, from_airtable/*) and every local database are never read by this export.
